question: Liberalisation is a part of ________ reforms.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**economic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Liberalisation** refers to the process of reducing government restrictions and regulations in the **economic sector** to encourage the participation of private entities, both domestic and foreign.
 
• It is a part of the **economic reforms** introduced in **India in 1991**, often referred to as the **New Economic Policy (NEP)**.
 
• The main aim of liberalisation is to promote **free-market policies** and reduce **state intervention** in economic activities.
